---
title: "Rule 5 board"
pagetitle: "Rule 5 draft board: eligible Triple-A players"
description: "Triple-A players likely eligible for the Rule 5 Draft and not on a 40-man roster, ranked on the numbers that carry to the majors."
page-layout: full
---

Every {{< meta baseball.season >}} Triple-A player who is likely eligible for the Rule 5 Draft and isn't on a 40-man roster, as of the {{< meta baseball.r5_snapshot >}} roster snapshot. Pitchers are graded on [Stuff+](/baseball/stuff-plus/) and strikeout-minus-walk rate, with [Location+ and Pitching+](/baseball/stuff-or-command/) alongside; hitters on swing decisions and contact quality, the numbers that [carry over best](/baseball/two-week-signal/). Eligibility is an **estimate** from signing dates and ages; hover a status for the reasoning. What the board shows and what it can't: [the Rule 5 board, explained](/baseball/rule-5/).

```{=html}
<div class="explorer">
  <div id="r5banner"></div>
  <div class="controls" id="c"></div>
  <div id="scatter" class="plot-host"></div>
  <p class="caption" id="scap"></p>
  <div id="t"><div class="loading">Loading…</div></div>
</div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const S = Sparvi, f = S.fmt, U = S.urlState;
  const [pitchers, hitters, meta] = await Promise.all(["rule5_pitchers", "rule5_hitters", "meta"].map(n => S.load(`/data/baseball/${n}.json`)));
  const R5 = meta.rule5, MIN_DEFAULT = 50;
  // Scales (S.SCALES): the "+" grades are on the MLB scale (100 = average qualified MLB pitcher), not a Triple-A one;
  // hitters' percentile columns are on the Triple-A scale (qualified Triple-A hitters).
  const REF = meta.scale_reference.reference_season, MLB_SCALE = S.SCALES.mlbAaa(REF), SM = meta.stuff_metrics;
  const aaaAvg = k => f.num(SM[`aaa_mean_${k}_plus_qualified`], 0);
  const DEF = { side: "pitchers", org: "", role: "all", pos: "all" };
  const POS = [["all", "All"], ["C", "Catchers"], ["IF", "Infield"], ["OF", "Outfield"]];
  const st = { side: U.get("side", DEF.side), org: U.get("org", DEF.org), role: U.get("role", DEF.role), q: "",
               pos: POS.some(([k]) => k === U.get("pos")) ? U.get("pos") : DEF.pos,
               min: U.get("min") == null ? null : +U.get("min"), agemax: U.get("agemax") == null ? null : +U.get("agemax") };
  const ap = f.apDate;
  if (R5.snapshot_date <= R5.protection_deadline) {
    document.getElementById("r5banner").replaceChildren(S.el("div", { class: "flag-list" },
      S.el("strong", {}, "Preliminary. "),
      `Rosters as of ${ap(R5.snapshot_date)}; clubs can protect players until the ${ap(R5.protection_deadline)} deadline, so some names here will be added to 40-man rosters. The board is final once it's rebuilt after the deadline.`));
  }
  const orgs = [...new Set(pitchers.concat(hitters).map(d => d.org))].filter(Boolean).sort();
  const c = document.getElementById("c");
  const roleHost = S.el("span", { class: "role-host" });
  function controls() {
    const pitch = st.side === "pitchers";
    c.replaceChildren(...[
      S.el("label", {}, "Players", S.seg([["pitchers", "Pitchers"], ["hitters", "Hitters"]], st.side, v => { st.side = v; st.role = "all"; st.pos = "all"; st.min = null; controls(); draw(); })),
      S.select("Organization", [["", "All 30"], ...orgs.map(o => [o, o])], st.org, v => { st.org = v; draw(); }),
      pitch ? roleHost : S.el("label", {}, "Position", S.seg(POS, st.pos, v => { st.pos = v; draw(); })),
      S.number("Max. age", st.agemax, 1, v => { st.agemax = v; draw(); }, "any"),
      S.number(pitch ? "Min. BF" : "Min. PA", st.min, 25, v => { st.min = v; draw(); }, String(MIN_DEFAULT)),
      S.search("Find a player", "Name", v => { st.q = v; draw(); }, st.q)].filter(Boolean));
  }
  const statusCell = r => `<span class="r5-status r5-${r.status.split(" ")[0].toLowerCase()}" title="${r.reason.replace(/"/g, "&quot;")}">${r.status}</span>`;
  const AAA_PCT = `Triple-A scale: percentile among qualified Triple-A hitters (${meta.min_pa_qualified}+ PA), 50 = the Triple-A median, higher is better`;
  const pc = (key, label, title) => ({ key, label, fmt: v => v == null ? "—" : Math.round(v), heat: "pct", heatVal: r => r[key], title: (title ? title + ". " : "") + AAA_PCT + "." });
  const pCols = [
    { key: "name", label: "Pitcher", align: "l", html: r => S.playerLink(r.player_id, r.name) },
    { key: "org", label: "Org", align: "l" }, { key: "age", label: "Age" },
    { key: "role", label: "Role", align: "l", title: "SP starter · RP reliever · Swing (see glossary)" },
    { key: "bf", label: "BF" },
    { key: "stuff_plus", label: "Stuff+", heat: "plus", fmt: v => f.num(v, 0), title: `What the ball does: velocity, movement, spin, release. ${MLB_SCALE}. Qualified Triple-A pitchers average ${aaaAvg("stuff")}.` },
    { key: "loc_plus", label: "Loc+", heat: "plus", fmt: v => f.num(v, 0), title: `Location+: where his pitches crossed the plate. Steady for a pitcher, but it hasn't carried from Triple-A to MLB results (see the stuff-or-command article). ${MLB_SCALE}. Qualified Triple-A pitchers average ${aaaAvg("loc")}.` },
    { key: "pitching_plus", label: "Pitching+", heat: "plus", fmt: v => f.num(v, 0), title: `Stuff and location together, from its own model (not an average of the other two). ${MLB_SCALE}. Qualified Triple-A pitchers average ${aaaAvg("pitching")}.` },
    { key: "k_pct", label: "K%", fmt: v => f.pct(v) }, { key: "bb_pct", label: "BB%", fmt: v => f.pct(v) },
    { key: "k_bb_pct", label: "K−BB%", fmt: v => f.pct(v), title: "Strikeout rate minus walk rate" },
    { key: "csw_pct", label: "CSW%", fmt: v => f.pct(v) }, { key: "fb_velo", label: "FB velo", fmt: v => f.num(v) },
    { key: "best_pt_stuff", label: "Best pitch", html: r => r.best_pt ? `${r.best_pt} <span class="muted">${f.num(r.best_pt_stuff, 0)}</span>` : "—", title: `His highest-graded pitch (50+ thrown) and its Stuff+. MLB scale within its pitch group: 100 = the average ${REF} MLB pitch of that group (fastballs, breaking balls, or offspeed).` },
    { key: "mlb_g", label: "MLB G", fmt: v => v || "—", title: `MLB games in ${meta.season}. Players outrighted off a 40-man stay on the board.` },
    { key: "status", label: "Eligibility", align: "l", html: statusCell, title: "Estimated from signing date and age; hover for the reasoning" },
  ];
  const slash = r => r.avg == null ? "—" : [r.avg, r.obp, r.slg].map(v => f.woba(v)).join("/");
  // Fielding at his main position. Catchers: base stealers thrown out and passed balls; everyone else: errors
  // and fielding percentage, which count plays made, not range.
  const defense = r => r.def_pos == null ? "—" : r.def_pos === "C"
    ? `CS ${r.c_cs ?? 0}/${(r.c_sb ?? 0) + (r.c_cs ?? 0)} · PB ${r.c_pb ?? 0}`
    : `${r.def_pos} ${r.def_fpct == null ? "—" : f.woba(r.def_fpct)}, ${r.def_e} E`;
  const hCols = [
    { key: "name", label: "Hitter", align: "l", html: r => S.playerLink(r.player_id, r.name) },
    { key: "org", label: "Org", align: "l" }, { key: "age", label: "Age" },
    { key: "pa", label: "PA" },
    pc("chase_pct_pctl", "Chase pctl", "Higher = chases less"),
    pc("zone_contact_pct_pctl", "Z-Contact pctl"), pc("ev90_pctl", "EV90 pctl", "90th-percentile exit velocity"),
    pc("hard_hit_pct_pctl", "Hard-hit pctl"),
    { key: "xwoba", label: "xwOBA", fmt: f.woba },
    { key: "slash", label: "AVG/OBP/SLG", html: slash, sortVal: r => (r.obp ?? 0) + (r.slg ?? 0), title: "Triple-A season line; sorts by OPS" },
    { key: "hr", label: "HR" }, { key: "sb", label: "SB", title: "Stolen bases; hover a dot for caught stealing" },
    { key: "defense", label: "Defense", align: "l", html: defense, sortVal: r => r.def_pos === "C" ? (r.c_cs_pct ?? -1) : (r.def_fpct ?? -1),
      title: "At his main position (most innings). Catchers: runners caught stealing out of attempts, and passed balls. Others: fielding percentage and errors, which don't measure range." },
    { key: "positions", label: "Positions (G)", align: "l", sortVal: r => -(r.n_positions ?? 0), fmt: v => v ?? "—",
      title: `Triple-A games at each position, most first. Sorting puts players with the most positions (${R5.versatile_g}+ games each) first.` },
    { key: "status", label: "Eligibility", align: "l", html: statusCell, title: "Estimated from signing date and age; hover for the reasoning" },
  ];
  let tbl, side;
  const host = document.getElementById("scatter");
  function draw() {
    const pitch = st.side === "pitchers", src = pitch ? pitchers : hitters, n = pitch ? "bf" : "pa";
    const pre = src.filter(d => d[n] >= (st.min ?? MIN_DEFAULT) && (st.agemax == null || d.age <= st.agemax));
    if (pitch) roleHost.replaceChildren(S.roleFilter(st.role, v => { st.role = v; draw(); }, { swing: pre.filter(d => d.role === "Swing").length }));
    const base = pre.filter(d => pitch ? (st.role === "all" || d.role === st.role) : (st.pos === "all" || d.pos_group === st.pos));
    const rows = base.filter(d => !st.org || d.org === st.org);
    const shown = st.q ? rows.filter(d => d.name.toLowerCase().includes(st.q)) : rows;
    if (side !== st.side) { tbl = S.table(document.getElementById("t"), pitch ? pCols : hCols, { sortKey: pitch ? "stuff_plus" : "ev90_pctl" }); side = st.side; }
    tbl.update(shown);
    U.set({ side: st.side, org: st.org, role: pitch ? st.role : "all", pos: pitch ? "all" : st.pos, min: st.min, agemax: st.agemax }, DEF);
    const hi = st.org || st.q ? shown : [];
    const X = pitch ? "stuff_plus" : "chase_pct_pctl", Y = pitch ? "k_bb_pct" : "ev90_pctl";
    const pts = base.filter(d => d[X] != null && d[Y] != null);
    S.plot(host, w => Plot.plot({ ...S.plotDefaults(w), height: 340, grid: true,
      x: pitch ? { label: "Stuff+ (MLB scale: 100 = MLB average) →", nice: true } : { label: "Chase percentile (higher = more disciplined) →", domain: [0, 100] },
      y: pitch ? { label: "↑ K−BB%", tickFormat: "%", nice: true } : { label: "↑ EV90 percentile", domain: [0, 100] },
      marks: [
        pitch ? Plot.ruleX([100], { stroke: "#8a8b8f", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }) : Plot.ruleX([50], { stroke: "#8a8b8f", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
        pitch ? null : Plot.ruleY([50], { stroke: "#8a8b8f", strokeDasharray: "3,3" }),
        Plot.dot(pts, { x: X, y: Y, r: 3.5, fill: "#c9c7c0", fillOpacity: 0.8 }),
        Plot.dot(hi.filter(d => d[X] != null && d[Y] != null), { x: X, y: Y, r: 6, fill: "#eb6834", stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 1.2 }),
        hi.length && hi.length <= 15 ? Plot.text(hi.filter(d => d[X] != null && d[Y] != null), { x: X, y: Y, text: d => d.name.split(" ").filter(w => !/^(Jr\.?|Sr\.?|II|III|IV)$/.test(w)).slice(-1)[0], dy: -11, fontSize: 10.5 }) : null,
        Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({ x: X, y: Y, title: d => `${d.name} (${d.org}${pitch ? `, ${d.role}` : `, ${d.position}`}, age ${d.age})\n` + (pitch
          ? `Stuff+ ${f.num(d.stuff_plus, 0)} · Location+ ${f.num(d.loc_plus, 0)} · Pitching+ ${f.num(d.pitching_plus, 0)}
K−BB ${f.pct(d.k_bb_pct)} · ${d.bf} BF`
          : `Chase pctl ${d.chase_pct_pctl} · EV90 pctl ${d.ev90_pctl} · ${d.pa} PA\n${slash(d)} · ${d.hr ?? 0} HR · ${d.sb ?? 0} SB, ${d.cs ?? 0} CS\n${d.positions ?? ""}`) + `\n${d.status}` }))] }));
    const who = pitch ? (st.role === "all" ? "pitchers" : S.ROLES[st.role].toLowerCase())
      : ({ all: "hitters", C: "catchers", IF: "infielders", OF: "outfielders" })[st.pos];
    document.getElementById("scap").textContent = (pitch
      ? `${rows.length} ${who} with ${st.min ?? MIN_DEFAULT}+ BF. Upper right is the profile that tends to translate: MLB-caliber stuff (right of the dashed line at 100) and a strong strikeout-to-walk margin. Stuff+, Loc+, and Pitching+ are on the MLB scale (100 = the average qualified MLB pitcher of ${REF}), not a Triple-A one: qualified Triple-A pitchers average ${aaaAvg("stuff")}, ${aaaAvg("loc")}, and ${aaaAvg("pitching")}. K%, BB%, CSW%, and velocity are raw Triple-A numbers.`
      : `${rows.length} ${who} with ${st.min ?? MIN_DEFAULT}+ PA (by the position he played most). Upper right: disciplined swing decisions and top-end contact quality. Percentiles are against qualified Triple-A hitters (${meta.min_pa_qualified}+ PA). The table adds each hitter's line, the positions he played, and his fielding.`)
      + (hi.length ? ` Orange: ${st.org || "search matches"}.` : " Pick an organization or search a name to highlight players.");
  }
  controls(); draw();
})();
</script>
```

::: {.note}
**Scales.** Stuff+, Loc+, Pitching+, and the best pitch's grade are on the **MLB scale**: 100 is the average qualified MLB pitcher of {{< meta baseball.scale_ref_season >}} and 10 points is one standard deviation, so 100 here means major-league-average, and the typical qualified Triple-A pitcher is about {{< meta baseball.stuff_aaa_mean >}} Stuff+, {{< meta baseball.loc_mean_aaa_cur >}} Location+, and {{< meta baseball.pitching_mean_aaa_cur >}} Pitching+ (Pitching+ is its own model; shortfalls in stuff and location add up, so its Triple-A average is below both). Hitters' percentile columns are on the **Triple-A scale**: percentiles among qualified Triple-A hitters. Rates, velocity, and slash lines are raw Triple-A numbers.

{{< meta baseball.season >}} regular-season Triple-A data. 40-man rosters as of {{< meta baseball.r5_snapshot >}}; the protection deadline is {{< meta baseball.r5_deadline >}} and the Rule 5 Draft is scheduled for {{< meta baseball.r5_draft >}}. Players who elected free agency after the season or were released aren't under contract and can't be drafted, so they're excluded. Hitters' lines, positions, and fielding are {{< meta baseball.season >}} Triple-A season totals from the MLB Stats API; fielding percentage counts errors, not range, so read it as a check, not a grade. Eligibility statuses: **Eligible** (signing date and age known), **Likely eligible** (signing date estimated from the draft year), **Unknown** (no signing record found). How the estimate works and how it checked out: [method](/baseball/rule-5/#method).
:::
